description: Example Hunger Games arena. Fastest setup: create/mark the place, stand at the arena centre on the floor, and use the Admin panel's Hunger Games section (or the wizard's Spawns step) -> 'Generate full layout here'. That lays a ring of tribute spawns, centres the storm zone, and places cornucopia/rare/common loot chests in one click; tune anything afterwards. Manual alternative: set spawnOffsets (one per tribute) and per-place BehaviorData['HungerGames'] = { X, Y, Z, InitialRadius, LootSpots: [{ X, Y, Z, Tier? }, ...] } via the panel buttons (tiers: common/rare/cornucopia).
